messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — planning staged unpin of runtime v2.14.1 from canary tomorrow 22:00 PT. Goal: validate runtime unpin behavior for long-seq traffic. Deploybot will do staggered unpins (10m). Link to notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.14.1-unpin

deploybot: Scheduled staged unpin: runtime=2.14.1 env=canary stagger=10m initiator=alice. To abort: `/deploybot abort staged-unpin 4820012345`.

chloe: Any known incompat with llama3q quant kernels? saw some kv-cache invalidation in sims.

ben: not from model side; infra saw a transient decoder_mem RSS bump in canary 3 hours ago; telemetry alerts might trigger auto-pause if `decoder_mem_rss_mb` > 12000 for 3m.

tim_ops: i'm oncall during window. i'll watch kv_cache_miss_rate and the rollout pause webhook. set me for paging if pause -> oncall escalates.

alice: added `telemetry_pause` policy to deploy: pause if decoder_mem_rss_mb > 12k OR kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.08 for 3m. Also added a manual `rollback-window` flag.

release-manager: pls add a short release note blurb and mark any customers on Dedicated who pinned to runtime 2.14.1.

ben: small runbook snippet for rollback if paused:
```
# rollback steps
/deploybot rollback --runtime 2.14.0 --env canary --reason "pause-threshold-trigger"
# verify metrics: kv_cache_miss_rate < 0.05, p50 token latency < 120ms
```

deploybot: If paused, auto-notify: `#eng-oncall`, `@tim_ops`, `@release-manager`. Auto-rollback is NOT enabled; requires manual `/deploybot rollback`.

chloe: will run a quick perf-sim against longseq corpora right now and paste results.

chloe: sim results: +7% decoder_mem, +0.02 kv miss on 10k seq test. not ideal but under pause threshold.

alice: ok leaving rollout scheduled. if pause happens -> we'll meet in #eng-releases-live and decide rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
